candidates.hypothesis: When market makers' signed net gamma is in its top quartile, fade the previous hour's ES return over the next 1-2 h
candidates.mechanism: Positive dealer gamma: delta hedging trades against price moves, strengthening order-flow reversal and compressing momentum
candidates.entry_window_ct: 10-minute marks in RTH, 08:30-13:10 CT to stay flat by 15:10
candidates.best_source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026
candidates.published_effect: Q4 net gamma: momentum returns about -1 to -2 bp (reversal) at 10 min-2 h; Q1-Q4 spread -1 to -3 bp at 30 min-2 h; Q1 about +0.7 bp at 1-2 h
candidates.price_level_used: ES 6,000 (sample-period levels were lower, which shrinks points)
candidates.dispersion: Q4 effect 'statistically significant at the 1- and 2-hour horizons'; no per-trade sd published in passages read
candidates.quote: negative momentum returns (or positive reversal returns) of around 1 - 2 bps across the investment horizons for the higher level of net gamma. The difference between the first and fourth quartile ranges between -1 and -3 bps across investment horizons between 30 minutes and 2 hours, and it is statistically significant.
candidates.decay_evidence: order-flow predictability 'decays toward zero within the hour'; no post-2024 test; authors: 'does not translate into a feasible trading strategy since the market makers' net gamma is not observable to other investors'
candidates.data_needed: Cboe Open-Close Volume intraday 10-minute SPX/SPXW by participant class; ES 1-min bars
candidates.data_cost: not fetched by R1 (R2 owns vendor pricing)
candidates.why: Published 'momentum return' is a first difference of buy-and-hold returns, not a signed position P&L; signal data not owned and not observable in real time per authors
candidates.prop_notes: intraday, low frequency, flat by 15:10 CT feasible; P06 binds on release days
candidates.overlap_note: Same dealer-gamma conditioning of momentum; differs by signed Cboe positions, high-gamma reversal, whole session vs last half-hour; index not re-grepped

evidence.quote: for the low net gamma quartile, the average return estimates are positive across all investment horizons, and they increase monotonically from almost zero in the next 10-minute interval to around 0.7 bps at the 1- and 2-hour horizons.
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026

evidence.quote: negative momentum returns (or positive reversal returns) of around 1 - 2 bps across the investment horizons for the higher level of net gamma.
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026

evidence.quote: this result does not translate into a feasible trading strategy since the market makers' net gamma is not observable to other investors.
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026

evidence.quote: Shifting 0DTE net gamma in a 10-minute interval by one standard deviation reduces predicted S&P 500 realized volatility by about 23 basis points (annualized) in the next 10-minute interval.
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026

evidence.quote: on days when 0DTE contracts expire, the 10-minute realized volatility of S&P 500 index returns is lower by 61 annualized basis points (bps) on average
evidence.source: Adams, Dim, Eraker, Fontaine, Ornthanalai, Vilkov, 'Do S&P 500 Options Increase Market Volatility? Evidence from 0DTEs', draft 15 Jul 2026

evidence.quote: We find that the maximum impact of OMM gamma on annualized volatility is to increase annualized daily volatility by 3.3 percentage points. The maximum impact of OMM gamma on annualized 30-minute volatility is to increase it by 6.4 percentage points.
evidence.source: Amaya, Garcia-Ares, Pearson, Vasquez, '0DTE Index Options and Market Volatility: How Large is Their Impact?', 25 Jan 2025

evidence.quote: the standard deviation of the gamma-induced change in 30-minute realized volatility is 0.9 percentage points. This is smaller than the standard deviation of changes in annualized 30-minute realized volatility due to all causes, which is 4.6 percentage points.
evidence.source: Amaya, Garcia-Ares, Pearson, Vasquez, '0DTE Index Options and Market Volatility: How Large is Their Impact?', 25 Jan 2025

evidence.claim: 0DTE option trading rules fail net of cost after correction
evidence.quote: the correction reverses the sign of the net-of-cost conclusions: no strategy or basket retains a positive net Sharpe ratio.
evidence.source: Vilkov, '0DTE Trading Rules: Tail Risk, Implementation, and Tactical Timing' replication package

evidence.number: put ratio -0.61, risk reversal +0.10, strangle -0.97, condor -2.67
evidence.quote: No structure retains a materially positive net Sharpe ratio.

evidence.claim: 0DTE OI gamma does not propagate volatility
evidence.quote: high open interest gamma in 0DTEs does not propagate past volatility.
evidence.source: Dim, Eraker, Vilkov, '0DTEs: Trading, Gamma Risk and Volatility Propagation', WFA version 14 May 2024 (SSRN 4692190)

evidence.quote: the difference in the magnitude of the average volatility response to 0DTE trading across the early and later sample period amounts to only 0.15 standard deviations of the return volatility, which is economically negligible.
evidence.source: Dim, Eraker, Vilkov, '0DTEs: Trading, Gamma Risk and Volatility Propagation', WFA version 14 May 2024 (SSRN 4692190)
